scenes.voice: Your AI just lied to you, and it had no idea.
scenes.headline: YOUR AI *LIED* TO YOU

scenes.voice: AI doesn't look up facts. It predicts the next most likely word.
scenes.headline: NEXT WORD *PREDICTION*
scenes.cardText: AI never searches a database of truths. It generates tokens probabilistically.

scenes.voice: So when it doesn't know, it still gives you something that sounds right.
scenes.headline: SOUNDS *RIGHT* BUT IS WRONG
scenes.cardText: Confidence has zero correlation with accuracy in large language models.

scenes.voice: Ask for a function that doesn't exist, and it will happily write the code.
scenes.headline: FABRICATING *CODE*

scenes.voice: The fix: ask for sources, run the code, and never trust blindly.
scenes.headline: NEVER TRUST *BLINDLY*

scenes.voice: Your AI just lied to you.
scenes.headline: YOUR AI *LIED* TO YOU
